trainingPhrases: toi can ho tro hoc vat ly
responses: Chao ban. Minh la Physical-Assistant, tro ly hoc tap cua ban. Minh co the giup ban tim bai hoc, vao roadmap game va goi y cach hoc nhanh.
Xin chao. Ban muon minh huong dan hoc theo lop hay vao game vat ly ngay?
Cam on ban. Chuc ban hoc tot va dat diem cao mon Vat ly.
Hen gap lai. Khi can goi y bai hoc hoac game, cu nhan minh nhe.
Ban vao Dashboard Vat ly tai duong dan: /program/physics/dashboard
Neu dang o trang khac, ban co the ve nhanh bang link: /program/physics/dashboard

trainingPhrases: mo lo trinh game vat ly
xem lo trinh tu lop 6 den 12
toi muon choi game theo roadmap
responses: Roadmap game Vat ly nam o: /physics-games/grades
Ban hay chon lop truoc, sau do mo game theo tung chuong de hoc co he thong.
Ban vao danh sach game theo lop tai: /physics-games/grade/$lop
Neu ban moi hoc, nen di theo thu tu chuong tu de den kho trong lop $lop.

trainingPhrases: toi can may tinh vat ly
responses: Trung tam cong cu Vat ly: /physics-tools
May tinh Vat ly: /physics-tools/calculator | Doi don vi: /physics-tools/converter | Hang so: /physics-tools/constants
Ban vao dashboard lop Vat ly tai: /physics-class/$lop
Sau do chon chuong va bai de hoc + lam game luyen tap.
Trang dang nhap: /
Neu chua co tai khoan, ban vao /register de tao moi.
Ban dang ky tai khoan tai: /register
Sau khi dang ky xong, ban quay lai trang dang nhap de vao he thong.
Trang ho so cua ban: /profile
Ban co the theo doi thong tin va tien do hoc tai day.

trainingPhrases: lam bai kiem tra dau vao
responses: Ban vao bai Placement Test tai: /placement-test
Hoan thanh bai test de nhan goi y lo trinh phu hop.

trainingPhrases: goi y cach hoc vat ly
responses: Goi y nhanh: 1) Hoc ly thuyet ngan theo bai. 2) Choi game chuong tuong ung. 3) Ghi lai loi sai hay gap. 4) Lam lai game kho sau 2-3 ngay.
Neu ban dang mat goc, hay bat dau tu lop hien tai trong roadmap: /physics-games/grades

trainingPhrases: goi y game de hoc luc
nen choi game nao ve nhiet hoc
goi y game de on quang hoc
responses: Ban vao /physics-games/grades, chon lop roi uu tien game theo dung chuong dang hoc tren lop.
Neu dang hoc Dien hoc, hay chon nhom game circuit, ohm-law va magnetic-field de on tong hop.
Trang chu he thong: /home
Neu muon chon chuong trinh hoc, ban vao: /program-selection
Minh chua hieu ro cau hoi. Ban thu hoi theo 1 trong 3 mau: 'vao roadmap vat ly', 'choi game lop 10', hoac 'mo cong cu vat ly'.
Ban co the noi ngan gon hon, vi du: 'vao profile', 'dang ky', 'placement test'.
